references.review_note: Selected visual direction; native controls and actual focus remain implementation work.
references.prompt: Create a high-fidelity UI concept image for a Google TV app called Postbox, for reviewing Twitter/X and Instagram posts saved from an Android phone. This is CONCEPT A, 'Evening library'. Output one flat full-bleed 16:9 television screen, no physical TV, no room mockup, no device chrome, high resolution. Art direction: warm near-black #131817 canvas, soft ivory typography, desaturated sage surfaces, restrained warm apricot focus ring, precise spacious native-TV layout. Premium editorial reading tool, understated, no sci-fi gradients, no glassmorphism. TV couch distance: large text, generous spacing, strong contrast, safe outer margins about 5%. Header: simple native bookmark symbol and Postbox at left, two calm tabs Saved and Archive toward center, large '+ Add posts' button at upper right. Main body: left 36% column headed 'Saved · 3'. A vertical list of THREE large cards: first card focused with a very obvious apricot outline and subtle scale, X source marker, title 'Small habits, lasting change', secondary label 'Saved text'. Second card Instagram marker, title 'A quieter place', secondary label 'Screenshot'. Third card X marker, title 'A post to revisit', secondary label 'Link only'. Right 58% spacious selected preview: small source label 'X · Saved text', large heading 'Small habits, lasting change', a comfortably readable 4-line body 'A useful habit starts small. Choose one thing you can repeat, make room for it, and return to it tomorrow.' A subtle divider then muted copy 'Captured on your phone'. At the bottom of preview a native-looking 'Read post' button, not focused. No likes, no comment icons, no follower counts, no AI summaries, no login avatars, no fake automatic sync, no huge thumbnail-heavy feed. Footer lower left simple '↑ ↓ Choose a post    OK Read    Back Exit'. Lower right 20% is quiet for independent clock overlay. Visually communicate a focused library and one selected post, NOT endless social media. All text crisp and correctly spelled. Compose-feasible native shapes and typography.

references.name: phone-capture

references.review_note: Approved phone capture direction; use Save on phone and explicit Send to TV.
references.prompt: Create a final UX concept board for Postbox Android companion, FOUR separate portrait flat Android screens in a horizontal row, generous legible typography. Consistent warm ink near-black canvas, ivory type, sage cards, warm apricot buttons. NO hardware frames. Each screen distinct state, no simultaneous before/after. Screen 1 CAPTURE: heading 'Save a post', one amber notice 'Only a link was shared', editable Link Instagram sample URL, Title 'A quieter place', Post text empty with placeholder 'Paste the caption or post text', 'Add image' button, main 'Save on phone' button, quiet plain status text 'Not sent to TV' (NOT button). Do not duplicate warning. Screen2 PHONE SAVED: heading 'Saved on phone', a Link only card 'A quieter place', note 'Add text or an image for TV reading', equal prominent actions 'Edit capture' and 'Connect TV', quiet 'Your draft stays on this phone'. Screen3 READY: heading 'Ready to send', named destination 'Postbox TV' with Connected status, a card titled 'A quieter place', label 'Instagram · Image', thumbnail image of a quiet cabin, primary 'Send to Postbox TV'; NO received or sent confirmation on this screen. Screen4 SUCCESS: heading 'Received on TV', clear green checkmark, sentence 'Saved on Postbox TV', matching capture A quieter place / Instagram · Image, quiet 'Your phone copy is kept', primary 'Save another post', secondary 'Back to library'; NO active send button. All controls correctly spelled, honest state progression. No AI, no account import, no fake retrieved captions, no disabled-looking status buttons. Distinct screens must make capture, local save, explicit send, durable receipt understandable in that order.

references.prompt: Create a high-fidelity UX concept board with TWO large 16:9 Google TV screens STACKED VERTICALLY (overall8:9 portrait). App Postbox. Style warm near-black ink #131817, sage panels, ivory LARGE plain sans-serif type, strong apricot SINGLE focus outline, generous 6% screen safe margins. Upper screen READER: header Postbox / Back to Saved; left 60% large native reading area labeled 'X · Saved text', title 'Small habits, lasting change', comfortably large several multiline paragraphs 'A useful habit starts small. Choose one thing you can repeat, make room for it, and return to it tomorrow.\n\nWhen progress feels slow, look for a simpler next step. Give it your full attention. Keep the part that helps and leave the rest.' Visible scroll affordance, a native side control stack 'Archive', 'Next post', 'View image'. Archive is focused. Include a small separate phone screenshot preview underneath source label 'Image added on phone', with clearly portrait proportions and no falsely extracted text. Caption 'View image to enlarge'. Lower screen ARCHIVE: header Postbox / Saved / Archive / + Add posts. Large title 'Archive · 1'. Left single list card 'A quieter place' / 'Instagram · Image'. Right selected preview shows cabin thumbnail, title 'A quieter place', 'Archived posts stay here until you restore or delete them.' Large 'Restore to Saved' focused button, secondary 'Delete' button with no confirmation shown. Footer left 'Back Saved'. Quiet bottom-right clock area on BOTH. No endless feed, no AI, no browser icons. Long text must read as captured text, image remains separate.

references.prompt: Design a clear UX concept board with TWO large 16:9 Google TV app screens stacked vertically, no device frames, overall aspect ratio 8:9 portrait. App 'Postbox', premium warm near-black #131817, sage native controls, ivory big sans-serif type, APRICOT focus outlines, match reference. Every essential UI INSIDE 6% screen margins. Upper screen is 'Empty Saved': header Postbox / Saved / Archive / Add posts, main large 'Your saved posts, on the big screen', then 'Share a post or screenshot from your Android phone.' Big focused button '+ Add posts', secondary 'Try an example' clearly sample. Small footer 'Your library stays on this TV'. No fake prefilled feed. Lower screen is 'Add posts': header Postbox and Back; big title 'Send from your phone'; large white QR code card at left (placeholder), readable right-side instructions: '1  Install Postbox on your Android phone', '2  Use the same Wi-Fi as this TV', '3  Enter the address and code shown here'.
